cases.initialization_requirement: All representation bytes required by T's validity must be initialized; padding need not be initialized.
cases.padding_guarantee: No guarantee that padding is initialized.

cases.initialization_requirement: Source must be a valid T.
cases.padding_guarantee: Semantic value is preserved; initialized padding may lose its value.
cases.additional: Copies containing references may implicitly reborrow and alter provenance.

cases.initialization_requirement: Contained bytes need not form a valid T.
cases.padding_guarantee: Contents/provenance of T's non-padding bytes are preserved; padding is not promised preserved.

cases.initialization_requirement: Source bytes need not form valid T values; pointer access/alignment/overlap requirements still apply.
cases.padding_guarantee: Initialization state is preserved exactly for all copied bytes.

cases.initialization_requirement: All-zero data representation must be valid for T.
cases.padding_guarantee: Returned typed padding is not necessarily zero.

cases.initialization_requirement: Every byte read as u8 must be initialized.
cases.padding_guarantee: A valid T can still have uninitialized padding, so an ordinary &[u8] view over the full representation can demand more initialization than T validity provides.
